coalescing_depth_strict.requirement: Any outcome-independent policy that drops a declared look admits an adversarial path where only that look crosses, so strict FIFO action dominance requires processing every look.

simulation.random_seed: SHA256-derived per case and sample size

bound.dominance_guarantee: global rate >= E93 pairwise true-winner rate
bound.event: candidate empirical regression <= every tested policy

guarantee.conservatism: A competitor tying the true winner need not become the global empirical winner, so the radius is safe but can be smaller than the exact bad-winner-region distance.
guarantee.event: empirical winner true regret <= declared tolerance
guarantee.radius: minimum pairwise L1 distance to an unacceptable competitor tying the true winner

key_findings.root_cause_of_e7_e110_gap: Unlocked A100 DVFS transitions between 1140 MHz default application clock and 1410 MHz max boost clock (1.237x SM frequency ratio) during 3-step warmup, not TorchInductor persistent-cache codegen regression.
